canonical_mechanism: RPC computes data.idempotencyKey in SQL from domain columns. ONE canonical unique index across channels, TRUSTED-ONLY (cut2_provenance_version = 1). All 17 live WhatsApp unique indexes DROP+CREATE same name with AND cut2_provenance_version = 1 (R4). Duplicate lookup ONLY provenance=1 + channel + template + idempotencyKey. NULL legacy NEVER returned. Conflict without trusted canonical row → trusted_idempotency_conflict_mismatch. NO UPDATE/DELETE/REQUEUE/REPLACE including failed rows. idempotencyKey is idempotency only — NOT trust evidence.
future_index_sql_plan_only_not_a_migrati: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_notifications_queue_cut2_semantic_idempotency_unique ON public.notifications_queue (channel, template, ((data ->> 'idempotencyKey'))) WHERE cut2_provenance_version = 1 AND NULLIF(BTRIM(data ->> 'idempotencyKey'), '') IS NOT NULL;
future_index_notes: SR3 revise (canonical, unchanged): WHERE cut2_provenance_version = 1 so legacy/NULL keys cannot poison the trusted canonical index.
No status predicate — queued, sent, AND failed TRUSTED rows participate.
Empty or null/blank idempotencyKey is excluded; RPC MUST always write a non-empty key for inserted trusted rows.

SR4: the 17 WA uniques are NOT left unscoped. DROP INDEX public.<same_name>; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX <same_name> ... WHERE (<EXACT EXISTING PREDICATE>) AND cut2_provenance_version = 1. Fingerprint old_exact_indexdef or CUT2_ABORT before DROP.
Do not author this SQL in this planning PR.
